key_insight: Performing image style transfer and mask-free video insertion together in a closed-loop dual-stream framework lets the reference object adapt its appearance to the target scene while the video stream enforces temporal and spatial coherence, producing photorealistic insertions despite large stylistic domain gaps.
problem_solved: Enables harmonious, mask-free insertion of reference objects into videos when the reference and target scenes have severe style/appearance differences — eliminating artifacts, mismatched styles, and temporal inconsistency that plague prior methods.
method: Dual-Stream architecture: an image stream that performs style transfer on the reference and a video stream that inserts the (styled) object into the target frames without requiring explicit object masks.

Closed-loop feedback between streams: the image stream guides appearance adaptation while the video stream returns temporal/spatial cues, enabling iterative refinement for photorealism and motion consistency.
End-to-end training with losses targeting photorealism and temporal coherence (e.g., perceptual/adversarial and flow/consistency losses) to jointly optimize style alignment and insertion quality.
impact: Reduces manual preprocessing and domain-mismatch failures for video object insertion, improving practical workflows in video editing, AR/VR, and synthetic data generation while delivering more realistic and temporally stable results.

paper_title: Smart-Insertion-V: Photorealistic Video Insertion via a Closed-Loop Feedback Dual-Stream Framework
paper_authors: Xiao Cao, Yansong Qu,  Xiangzhen,  Chang, Wen Xiao
